title: Windsurf dotfile candidate and its closing step
description: Add a new dotfile candidate, then close out the change the way this project usually does, without being told how.
prompt: Dotstate needs to treat Windsurf's global rules directory as a recognized dotfile. Add a new `DotfileCandidate` entry for `.windsurf/rules` to the AI-tools section of `src/dotfile_candidates.rs`, with a one-line description in the style of the entries around it. Do not modify any other file.
follow_up_prompt: Thanks — before you call this finished, close this change out the way this project expects for a change like this one — in the repo itself, following the project's own convention, not just marking your own work as done.
solution_markers: must also get a matching bullet
